segments.oily: One reviewer with sometimes-oily skin reports the patches stick well and are non-irritating.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no irritation and effective results shrinking pimples.
segments.mature: One reviewer going through menopause describes the patches as a life saver for unexpected breakouts on previously clear skin.

concerns.aging: One menopausal reviewer reports the patches help with new breakouts appearing as her skin changes; no other aging-specific comments are present.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the patches reduce redness and calm active spots; no dissent noted.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible reduction or disappearance of pimples overnight or within a few days, including whiteheads and occasional zits; several note deep or cystic pimples take longer (a few days) or are less affected, and multiple reviewers state the patches did nothing at all for their pimples.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report reduced size, faster healing and less scarring of blemishes; a few report no visible change or the blemish returning after removal.

extraits.texte: I'm going through menopause and my skin, which has always been flawless, is going through it right now. These are a life saver. I've tried other patches and these are by far the best. Flawless results by morning!
These are great for shrinking pimples and they get rid of blemishes much quicker than other methods. They do not bother my sensitive skin at all.

extraits.titre: Good for preventing picking at spots
extraits.texte: These are cute and straightforward! They're a good overnight "bandage" to prevent pimples from getting rubbed or poked at, and it's kind of satisfying to peel them off in the morning and see the gunk that's been collected. IMO, you get a good number of spot dots in this package for the price + quality (compared to other options at the drugstore). These stick to my sometimes-oily skin well and they are non-irritating. They seem to help drain or partially-drain whiteheads overnight, which helps with the healing time & reducing their visibility the next day.

I bought these pimple patches over other brands thinking "surely all pimple patches are the same thing and these ones are noticeably cheaper than the others," and quickly learned that not all pimple patches are created equal. I liked the different sizes, but of the 30 on a sheet, about 10-12 of mine were stuck to the top wrapper rather than the backing, which made it hard to apply without diminishing the adhesive. These pimple patches were far less sticky than other brands I have used so they didn't stay on very well, they are much more visible on the skin, and they seemed to work less. They also have a sticky residue around the edges on the outside, so they got gunky and felt kind of gross. Overall, I was surprisingly disappointed and wish I wouldve just bought the more expensive brands, it's worth it.

extraits.titre: A must have for pimple poppers
extraits.texte: On cystic pimples it doesn't work quickly, may take a few days but for the occasional zit, these work well overnight and stay put.

extraits.titre: We purchase Hero Acne Dots again & again
extraits.texte: With three teenage grandkids I gift Hero acne dots often. They work really well to reduce redness, dryout & heal active eruptions. The kids love em.

I have PCOS and get the occasional flare up of acne. I have a painful pimple cone up on my upper lip and put one on it. I have never tried patches before and the pain instantly was relieved after applying. I had already had one patch on my cheek that had absorbed impurities. I had no issues with it staying on or with peeling off. I also had no issues with any type of reaction. When looking at reviews to purchase a product like this remember that everyone's skin is different.
